exclusions.source_text: Participants must have Zubrod Performance Status of 0-3 as determined by a history and physical (H\&P) exam completed within 14 days prior to registration

Participants must have newly diagnosed, untreated acute myeloid leukemia (AML) defined by having ≥ 20% blasts in the bone marrow and/or peripheral blood, or with an AML defining genetic abnormality as described by the World Health Organization (WHO) classification of AML, excluding acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) with PML-RARA
